info.description: The Education Enrollments Grades API allows for retrieving detailed information about student grades associated with their enrollments in educational programs. This endpoint provides support for institutions looking to access and analyze academic performance data. Typical consumers include educational administrators and data analysts who require insights into student performance metrics. Operations include querying for specific grade records, enabling efficient reporting and effective decision-making within educational contexts.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to retrieve the grades associated with various enrollments. It provides insights into student performance across different courses and assessments.
